requirements.note: Bachelor 4-year equivalent; GPA 3 overall/life sciences; research strongly valued. Three faculty letters, prefer 1–2 research supervisors; statement less than 2 pages, faculty interests and goals; CV. TOEFL 100 within 2 years if undergraduate education in non-native-English country. Three laboratory rotations before permanent adviser.

english.note: Central catalog accepts qualifying US/native-English-country bachelor or English testing; program may set stricter threshold. Current central score page inaccessible. Department publishes TOEFL 100; no new-scale equivalent or IELTS threshold inferred.
